items.title: Barceló Has the Cash to Buy Hotels, But Says They’re Too Expensive
items.summary: Record profits don’t necessarily mean it’s time to buy. Barceló has the cash to acquire hotels but says today’s prices no longer justify the returns it expects.

items.title: Why The Travel Industry Needs Conversations Like Skift Global Forum More Than Ever
items.summary: For more than a decade, Skift Global Forum has been the room where travel's most consequential decisions take shape. The 2026 edition arrives at a moment when the industry can least afford to form those decisions anywhere else.

items.title: The Airline CEOs Who Don’t Leave
items.summary: Michael O'Leary has tied himself to Ryanair until 2032. He belongs to a shrinking class of airline chiefs who have become almost impossible to replace – which is exactly what makes their eventual departures so risky.

items.title: Not For Sale: Sandals CEO Shuts Down Deal Rumors
